mutation_targets.rationale: F_AccessControl is the load-bearing constraint tying (relationship, opKind) to the permission matrix. Clearing it removes the link; the injection forces an explicit sharee-doing-DELETE success, which the matrix forbids — so LeastPrivilege and the related FRs must produce a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AccessControlViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = SuccessOutcome and op.opKind = DeleteTask and some op.targetTask and op.caller in op.targetTask.sharedWith and op.caller != op.targetTask.owner and op.caller.userRole = MemberRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets two AuditEntries describe the same logical operation event (a rewrite/duplicate), which is exactly what append-only forbids. The injection forces two such entries to coexist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.forOperation = ae2.forOperation }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this removes the requirement that every successful mutating operation be backed by an audit entry; the injection constructs an orphan state change — a successful PATCH with no matching AuditEntry — which violates the per-event audit invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanMutation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = SuccessOutcome and op.opKind = PatchFields and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.forOperation = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this lets an AuditEntry record an actor that is not the operation's caller, i.e., misattribution. The injection forces a recordedActor mismatch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.recordedActor != ae.forOperation.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets a sharee live in a different team than the task — exactly the cross-team-sharing escape FR-012 prohibits. The injection makes such a configuration exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShare { some t: Task, u: t.sharedWith | u.userTeam != t.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the gate forcing successful operations to be authenticated. The injection produces a successful unauthenticated operation, breaking the auth invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthenticatedSuccess { some op: Operation | op.outcome = SuccessOutcome and op.auth = Unauthenticated }
